OD_3_NARROW_REOPENING.what_is_reopened: Only the posture, and only by splitting it per event class.

EVENT_A_INITIAL_CORPUS.relation_to_historical_intent: PRESERVED. No write loss is accepted; the no-intervening-write guarantee is delivered by an empty window rather than by a prevention act.

EVENT_B_STAGE_A.relation_to_historical_intent: REVERSED FOR THIS CLASS ONLY. The owner now accepts the loss of unexpected staging writes inside a quantified, bounded exposure. This is a reversal and is recorded as one.

ANY_OTHER_CLASS.relation_to_historical_intent: No posture. The window STOPS. Neither QUIESCE nor ACCEPT is inherited by default.

The owner, who alone may reopen OD-3 (v1.0.0 reopening_rule; quiesce SECTION_B8), has reopened it for that reason and no other.
